WITH users_7day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
  UNNEST(event_params) as ep
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201101' AND '20210131'
    AND ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec'
    AND ep.value.int_value > 0
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20210101' AND '20210107'
),
users_2day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
  UNNEST(event_params) as ep
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201101' AND '20210131'
    AND ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec'
    AND ep.value.int_value > 0
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20210106' AND '20210107'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as distinct_pseudo_users
FROM users_7day u7
WHERE u7.user_pseudo_id NOT IN (SELECT user_pseudo_id FROM users_2day)

-- Get the top product
WITH youtube_buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h
  LEFT JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
    AND LOWER(p.v2ProductCategory) LIKE '%youtube%'
    AND p.productQuantity > 0
),
buyer_products AS (
  SELECT 
    s.fullVisitorId,
    p.v2ProductName,
    p.productSKU,
    p.productQuantity
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s,
  UNNEST(s.hits) AS h
  LEFT JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
    AND s.fullVisitorId IN (SELECT fullVisitorId FROM youtube_buyers)
    AND p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
    AND LOWER(p.v2ProductName) NOT LIKE '%youtube%'
    AND p.productQuantity > 0
)
SELECT 
  v2ProductName,
  SUM(productQuantity) AS total_quantity
FROM buyer_products
GROUP BY v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

sessions AS (

WITH inpatient_costs AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(SUBSTR(_TABLE_SUFFIX, 1, 4) AS INT64) AS year,
    AVG(average_medicare_payments * total_discharges) AS avg_inpatient_cost
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
    AND provider_id = '330101'
  GROUP BY year
),
outpatient_costs AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(SUBSTR(_TABLE_SUFFIX, 1, 4) AS INT64) AS year,
    AVG(average_total_payments * outpatient_services) AS avg_outpatient_cost
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
    AND provider_id = '330101'
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT 
  i.year,
  ROUND(i.avg_inpatient_cost, 2) AS yearly_avg_inpatient_cost,
  ROUND(o.avg_outpatient_cost, 2) AS yearly_avg_outpatient_cost
FROM inpatient_costs i
JOIN outpatient_costs o ON i.year = o.year
ORDER BY i.year

quinapril_users AS (

users AS (

WITH storm_points AS (
  SELECT 
    sid, name, iso_time, latitude, longitude, usa_wind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) as point_num
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
  WHERE season = '2020' AND basin = 'NA' AND sid = '2020256N11329'
),
storm_segments AS (
  SELECT 
    sp1.sid, sp1.name, sp1.iso_time, sp1.latitude, sp1.longitude, sp1.usa_wind,
    sp1.point_num,
    COALESCE(ST_DISTANCE(
      ST_GEOGPOINT(sp1.longitude, sp1.latitude),
      ST_GEOGPOINT(sp2.longitude, sp2.latitude)
    ) / 1000, 0) as segment_distance_km
  FROM storm_points sp1
  LEFT JOIN storm_points sp2 ON sp1.sid = sp2.sid AND sp1.point_num + 1 = sp2.point_num
)
SELECT 
  iso_time,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  usa_wind,
  COALESCE(SUM(segment_distance_km) OVER (ORDER BY iso_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) as cumulative_distance_km
FROM storm_segments
ORDER BY iso_time

WITH country_stats AS (
  SELECT gs.date,
         st.country,
         AVG(gs.temp) as avg_temp,
         AVG(gs.max) as avg_max,
         AVG(gs.min) as avg_min
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2023` gs
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` st ON gs.stn = st.usaf AND gs.wban = st.wban
  WHERE gs.date BETWEEN '2023-10-01' AND '2023-10-31'
    AND gs.temp != 9999.9
    AND gs.max != 9999.9
    AND gs.min != 9999.9
    AND st.country IN ('US', 'UK')
  GROUP BY gs.date, st.country
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT date,
         MAX(CASE WHEN country = 'US' THEN avg_temp END) as us_avg_temp,
         MAX(CASE WHEN country = 'US' THEN avg_max END) as us_avg_max,
         MAX(CASE WHEN country = 'US' THEN avg_min END) as us_avg_min,
         MAX(CASE WHEN country = 'UK' THEN avg_temp END) as uk_avg_temp,
         MAX(CASE WHEN country = 'UK' THEN avg_max END) as uk_avg_max,
         MAX(CASE WHEN country = 'UK' THEN avg_min END) as uk_avg_min
  FROM country_stats
  GROUP BY date
)
SELECT date,
       ROUND(us_avg_max - uk_avg_max, 1) as max_temp_diff,
       ROUND(us_avg_min - uk_avg_min, 1) as min_temp_diff,
       ROUND(us_avg_temp - uk_avg_temp, 1) as avg_temp_diff
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY date

WITH stations_in_range AS (
  SELECT usaf, wban, name, lat, lon, state
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`
  WHERE ST_DWITHIN(
    ST_GEOGPOINT(-73.764, 41.197),
    ST_GEOGPOINT(lon, lat),
    32186.9
  )
),
temp_data AS (
  SELECT stn, wban, year, 
         SUM(CASE WHEN temp != 9999.9 AND temp IS NOT NULL AND count_temp > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid_temp_obs
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2011`
  GROUP BY stn, wban, year
  UNION ALL
  SELECT stn, wban, year, 
         SUM(CASE WHEN temp != 9999.9 AND temp IS NOT NULL AND count_temp > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid_temp_obs
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2012`
  GROUP BY stn, wban, year
  UNION ALL
  SELECT stn, wban, year, 
         SUM(CASE WHEN temp != 9999.9 AND temp IS NOT NULL AND count_temp > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid_temp_obs
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2013`
  GROUP BY stn, wban, year
  UNION ALL
  SELECT stn, wban, year, 
         SUM(CASE WHEN temp != 9999.9 AND temp IS NOT NULL AND count_temp > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid_temp_obs
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2014`
  GROUP BY stn, wban, year
  UNION ALL
  SELECT stn, wban, year, 
         SUM(CASE WHEN temp != 9999.9 AND temp IS NOT NULL AND count_temp > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid_temp_obs
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2015`
  GROUP BY stn, wban, year
  UNION ALL
  SELECT stn, wban, year, 
         SUM(CASE WHEN temp != 9999.9 AND temp IS NOT NULL AND count_temp > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid_temp_obs
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2016`
  GROUP BY stn, wban, year
  UNION ALL
  SELECT stn, wban, year, 
         SUM(CASE WHEN temp != 9999.9 AND temp IS NOT NULL AND count_temp > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid_temp_obs
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2017`
  GROUP BY stn, wban, year
  UNION ALL
  SELECT stn, wban, year, 
         SUM(CASE WHEN temp != 9999.9 AND temp IS NOT NULL AND count_temp > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid_temp_obs
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2018`
  GROUP BY stn, wban, year
  UNION ALL
  SELECT stn, wban, year, 
         SUM(CASE WHEN temp != 9999.9 AND temp IS NOT NULL AND count_temp > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid_temp_obs
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`
  GROUP BY stn, wban, year
  UNION ALL
  SELECT stn, wban, year, 
         SUM(CASE WHEN temp != 9999.9 AND temp IS NOT NULL AND count_temp > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid_temp_obs
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2020`
  GROUP BY stn, wban, year
)
SELECT s.usaf, s.wban, s.name, s.lat, s.lon, s.state, 
       COALESCE(SUM(t.valid_temp_obs), 0) as total_valid_temp_observations
FROM stations_in_range s
LEFT JOIN temp_data t ON s.usaf = t.stn
GROUP BY s.usaf, s.wban, s.name, s.lat, s.lon, s.state
ORDER BY total_valid_temp_observations DESC

-- Full query with Pearson correlation rounded to 4 decimals - show all rows
WITH daily_temp AS (
  SELECT 
    CONCAT(CAST(year AS STRING), '-', LPAD(mo, 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(da, 2, '0')) as date_str,
    AVG(temp) as avg_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2008' AND '2017'
    AND stn IN ('725030', '744860') 
    AND temp != 9999.9 
    AND temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY date_str
),
daily_complaints AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(DATE(created_date) AS STRING) as date_str,
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as complaint_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE created_date >= '2010-01-01' AND created_date < '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY date_str, complaint_type
),
daily_totals AS (
  SELECT date_str, SUM(complaint_count) as total_daily_complaints
  FROM daily_complaints
  GROUP BY date_str
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    dt.date_str,
    dt.avg_temp,
    dc.complaint_type,
    dc.complaint_count,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(dc.complaint_count, dtot.total_daily_complaints) as pct_of_total
  FROM daily_temp dt
  JOIN daily_complaints dc ON dt.date_str = dc.date_str
  JOIN daily_totals dtot ON dt.date_str = dtot.date_str
),
qualifying_types AS (
  SELECT complaint_type
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING SUM(complaint_count) > 5000
),
corr_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    j.complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as n,
    SUM(j.avg_temp) as sum_x,
    SUM(j.complaint_count) as sum_y1,
    SUM(j.avg_temp * j.complaint_count) as sum_xy1,
    SUM(j.avg_temp * j.avg_temp) as sum_x2,
    SUM(j.complaint_count * j.complaint_count) as sum_y1_sq,
    SUM(j.pct_of_total) as sum_y2,
    SUM(j.avg_temp * j.pct_of_total) as sum_xy2,
    SUM(j.pct_of_total * j.pct_of_total) as sum_y2_sq,
    COUNT(DISTINCT j.date_str) as num_days
  FROM joined j
  WHERE j.complaint_type IN (SELECT complaint_type FROM qualifying_types)
  GROUP BY complaint_type
),
corr_results AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    num_days as total_days_with_valid_temp,
    sum_y1 as total_complaints,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
      n * sum_xy1 - sum_x * sum_y1,
      SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y1_sq - sum_y1 * sum_y1))
    ), 4) as corr_temp_count,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
      n * sum_xy2 - sum_x * sum_y2,
      SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2_sq - sum_y2 * sum_y2))
    ), 4) as corr_temp_pct
  FROM corr_stats
)
SELECT 
  complaint_type,
  total_days_with_valid_temp,
  total_complaints,
  corr_temp_count,
  corr_temp_pct
FROM corr_results
WHERE ABS(corr_temp_count) > 0.5 OR ABS(corr_temp_pct) > 0.5
ORDER BY ABS(COALESCE(corr_temp_count, 0)) DESC

-- Final query with proper formatting
WITH y1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(
      REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(spc_latin)), r' VAR\..*', ''), 
      r' X ', ' ')), r'\s+', ' ') as normalized_spc_latin,
    COUNT(*) as total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('Good', 'Excellent', 'Fair', 'Critical', 'Unknown') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as alive,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Dead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dead
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(spc_latin) != '' AND UPPER(TRIM(spc_latin)) != 'PLANTING SITE'
  GROUP BY normalized_spc_latin
),
species_common AS (
  SELECT normalized_spc_latin, spc_common,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY normalized_spc_latin ORDER BY cnt DESC) as rn
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(spc_latin)), r' VAR\..*', ''), 
        r' X ', ' ')), r'\s+', ' ') as normalized_spc_latin,
      spc_common,
      COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
    WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(spc_latin) != ''
    GROUP BY normalized_spc_latin, spc_common
  )
),
y2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(
      REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(spc_latin)), r' VAR\..*', ''), 
      r' X ', ' ')), r'\s+', ' ') as normalized_spc_latin,
    COUNT(*) as total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Alive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as alive,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Dead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dead
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(spc_latin) != ''
  GROUP BY normalized_spc_latin
)
SELECT 
  y1.normalized_spc_latin as spc_latin,
  COALESCE(sc.spc_common, '') as spc_common,
  SAFE_CAST(y1.total AS INT64) as total_1995,
  SAFE_CAST(y2.total AS INT64) as total_2015,
  SAFE_CAST(y1.alive AS INT64) as alive_1995,
  SAFE_CAST(y2.alive AS INT64) as alive_2015,
  SAFE_CAST(y1.dead AS INT64) as dead_1995,
  SAFE_CAST(y2.dead AS INT64) as dead_2015,
  SAFE_CAST(y2.total - y1.total AS INT64) as total_diff,
  SAFE_CAST(y2.alive - y1.alive AS INT64) as alive_diff,
  SAFE_CAST(y2.dead - y1.dead AS INT64) as dead_diff
FROM y1995 y1
INNER JOIN y2015 y2 ON y1.normalized_spc_latin = y2.normalized_spc_latin
LEFT JOIN species_common sc ON y1.normalized_spc_latin = sc.normalized_spc_latin AND sc.rn = 1
ORDER BY total_diff DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH filtered_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    t.pickup_location_id,
    t.tip_amount,
    t.total_amount,
    t.fare_amount,
    t.passenger_count,
    t.trip_distance,
    t.tolls_amount,
    t.mta_tax,
    tz.borough AS pickup_borough
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` tz
    ON t.pickup_location_id = tz.zone_id
  WHERE t.pickup_datetime >= '2016-01-01'
    AND t.pickup_datetime < '2016-01-08'
    AND tz.borough NOT IN ('EWR', 'Staten Island')
    AND t.dropoff_datetime > t.pickup_datetime
    AND t.passenger_count > 0
    AND t.trip_distance >= 0
    AND t.tip_amount >= 0
    AND t.tolls_amount >= 0
    AND t.mta_tax >= 0
    AND t.fare_amount >= 0
    AND t.total_amount >= 0
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    pickup_borough,
    CASE 
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 = 0 THEN '0%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 <= 5 THEN 'up to 5%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 <= 10 THEN '5% to 10%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 <= 15 THEN '10% to 15%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 <= 20 THEN '15% to 20%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 <= 25 THEN '20% to 25%'
      ELSE 'more than 25%'
    END AS tip_category
  FROM filtered_trips
)
SELECT 
  pickup_borough,
  tip_category,
  COUNT(*) AS tip_count,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(*), SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY pickup_borough)), 6) AS proportion
FROM classified
GROUP BY pickup_borough, tip_category
ORDER BY pickup_borough, tip_category

SELECT 
    t.route_id,
    t.trip_headsign,
    MIN(st1.departure_time) as earliest_clay_departure,
    MAX(st2.arrival_time) as latest_sacramento_arrival
FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.stop_times` st1
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.stop_times` st2 
    ON st1.trip_id = st2.trip_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.trips` t
    ON CAST(st1.trip_id AS STRING) = t.trip_id
WHERE st1.stop_id = 14015 
    AND st2.stop_id = 16294
    AND st1.stop_sequence < st2.stop_sequence
GROUP BY t.route_id, t.trip_headsign
ORDER BY t.route_id, t.trip_headsign

WITH covid_data AS (
  SELECT 
    country_name,
    iso_3166_1_alpha_3 AS country_code_3,
    cumulative_confirmed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
  WHERE date = DATE('2020-06-30') 
    AND aggregation_level = 0
),
pop_data AS (
  SELECT 
    country,
    country_code,
    year_2018 AS population_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_global_population.population_by_country`
  WHERE year_2018 IS NOT NULL AND year_2018 > 0
    AND country_code NOT IN ('LMC','LIC','LMH','UMC','HIC','INX','ARB')
)
SELECT 
  c.country_name,
  c.country_code_3,
  c.cumulative_confirmed,
  p.population_2018,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(c.cumulative_confirmed, p.population_2018) * 100, 2) AS confirmed_percentage
FROM covid_data c
JOIN pop_data p ON c.country_code_3 = p.country_code
ORDER BY confirmed_percentage DESC

WITH daily_new AS (
  SELECT date, county, state_name, confirmed_cases,
         confirmed_cases - LAG(confirmed_cases) OVER (PARTITION BY county ORDER BY date) AS daily_new_cases
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_nyt.us_counties`
  WHERE date BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND '2020-05-31'
    AND state_name = 'Illinois'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT date, county, daily_new_cases,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY date ORDER BY daily_new_cases DESC) as rn
  FROM daily_new
  WHERE daily_new_cases IS NOT NULL AND daily_new_cases > 0
)
SELECT county, COUNT(*) as times_in_top5
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 5
GROUP BY county
ORDER BY times_in_top5 DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH target_point AS (
  SELECT ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.191667, 47.685833) AS pt
),
target_zips AS (
  SELECT z.zip_code, z.zip_code_geom
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z, target_point
  WHERE z.state_code = 'WA'
    AND ST_DWITHIN(z.zip_code_geom, target_point.pt, 5 * 1609.344)
),
tract_overlaps AS (
  SELECT 
    tz.zip_code,
    t.geo_id AS tract_geo_id,
    ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(t.tract_geom, tz.zip_code_geom)) AS overlap_area,
    ST_AREA(t.tract_geom) AS tract_area
  FROM target_zips tz
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_tracts.census_tracts_washington` t
    ON ST_INTERSECTS(t.tract_geom, tz.zip_code_geom)
  WHERE ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(t.tract_geom, tz.zip_code_geom)) > 0
),
tract_data AS (
  SELECT geo_id, total_pop, income_per_capita
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2017_5yr`
),
allocated AS (
  SELECT 
    to2.zip_code,
    to2.tract_geo_id,
    to2.overlap_area,
    to2.tract_area,
    td.total_pop,
    td.income_per_capita,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(to2.overlap_area, to2.tract_area) AS ratio,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(to2.overlap_area, to2.tract_area) * td.total_pop AS allocated_pop,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(to2.overlap_area, to2.tract_area) * td.total_pop * td.income_per_capita AS allocated_total_income
  FROM tract_overlaps to2
  JOIN tract_data td ON to2.tract_geo_id = td.geo_id
)
SELECT 
  zip_code,
  ROUND(SUM(allocated_pop), 0) AS total_population,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(allocated_total_income), SUM(allocated_pop)), 1) AS avg_individual_income
FROM allocated
GROUP BY zip_code
ORDER BY avg_individual_income DESC

WITH top_venues AS (
  SELECT 
    'Top Venues' AS category,
    'N/A' AS date,
    venue_name AS matchup,
    venue_capacity AS key_metric
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_teams`
  WHERE venue_capacity IS NOT NULL
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY venue_capacity DESC) <= 5
),
biggest_championship_margins AS (
  SELECT 
    'Biggest Championship Margins' AS category,
    CAST(game_date AS STRING) AS date,
    CONCAT(win_market, ' vs ', lose_market) AS matchup,
    (win_pts - lose_pts) AS key_metric
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_historical_tournament_games`
  WHERE round = 2
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (win_pts - lose_pts) DESC) <= 5
),

WITH region_variants AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.gnomAD.v3_genomes__chr1` as t
  WHERE t.reference_name = 'chr1' 
    AND t.start_position >= 55039447 
    AND t.end_position <= 55064852
),
gene_symbols AS (
  SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT vep.SYMBOL, ', ' ORDER BY vep.SYMBOL) as distinct_gene_symbols
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.gnomAD.v3_genomes__chr1` as t,
       UNNEST(t.alternate_bases) as ab,
       UNNEST(ab.vep) as vep
  WHERE t.reference_name = 'chr1' 
    AND t.start_position >= 55039447 
    AND t.end_position <= 55064852
    AND vep.SYMBOL IS NOT NULL 
    AND vep.SYMBOL != ''
)
SELECT 
  rv.number_of_variants,
  rv.total_allele_count_AN,
  rv.total_alternate_allele_count,
  gs.distinct_gene_symbols,
  CAST(55064852 - 55039447 AS FLOAT64) / rv.number_of_variants as mutation_density
FROM (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as number_of_variants,
    SUM(AN) as total_allele_count_AN,
    SUM(total_ac) as total_alternate_allele_count
  FROM region_variants

-- Final calculation: net difference between PAAD patients with both KRAS and TP53 PASS mutations

WITH paad_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT bcr_patient_barcode as ParticipantBarcode
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_clinical_PANCAN_patient_with_followup`
    WHERE acronym = 'PAAD'
),
paad_mutations AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ParticipantBarcode,
        Hugo_Symbol
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample`
    WHERE Study = 'PAAD'
        AND Hugo_Symbol IN ('KRAS', 'TP53')
        AND FILTER = 'PASS'
),
patient_gene_status AS (
    SELECT 
        p.ParticipantBarcode,
        MAX(CASE WHEN m.Hugo_Symbol = 'KRAS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_kras,
        MAX(CASE WHEN m.Hugo_Symbol = 'TP53' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_tp53
    FROM paad_patients p
    LEFT JOIN paad_mutations m ON p.ParticipantBarcode = m.ParticipantBarcode
    GROUP BY p.ParticipantBarcode
)
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 1 AND has_tp53 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as patients_with_both,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 0 AND has_tp53 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as patients_with_neither,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 1 AND has_tp53 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 0 AND has_tp53 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as net_difference
FROM patient_gene_status

LEFT JOIN any_cat_images ac ON a.image_id = ac.image_id

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id) AS distinct_users
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210101' AND '20210131'
  AND event_name = 'page_view'
  AND (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location') = 'https://shop.googlemerchandisestore.com/'

WITH page_views AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_title') AS page_title,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location') AS page_location
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX = '20210128'
    AND user_pseudo_id = '1362228.4966015575'
    AND event_name = 'page_view'
),
url_parts AS (
  SELECT
    page_title,
    event_timestamp,
    ARRAY(SELECT part FROM UNNEST(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) AS part WHERE part != '') AS non_empty_parts,
    ARRAY_LENGTH(ARRAY(SELECT part FROM UNNEST(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) AS part WHERE part != '')) AS num_non_empty
  FROM page_views
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    page_title,
    event_timestamp,
    IF(num_non_empty >= 5, non_empty_parts[OFFSET(3)], NULL) AS seg4,
    IF(num_non_empty >= 5, non_empty_parts[OFFSET(4)], NULL) AS seg5,
    IF(num_non_empty >= 1, non_empty_parts[OFFSET(num_non_empty - 1)], NULL) AS last_seg,
    num_non_empty >= 5 AS has_enough_segments
  FROM url_parts
),
classified2 AS (
  SELECT
    page_title,
    event_timestamp,
    seg4,
    seg5,
    last_seg,
    has_enough_segments,
    REGEXP_CONTAINS(REPLACE(LOWER(seg4), '+', ' '), r'(accessories|apparel|brands|campus collection|drinkware|electronics|google redesign|lifestyle|nest|new 2015 logo|notebooks journals|office|shop by brand|small goods|stationery|wearables)') 
      OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(REPLACE(LOWER(seg5), '+', ' '), r'(accessories|apparel|brands|campus collection|drinkware|electronics|google redesign|lifestyle|nest|new 2015 logo|notebooks journals|office|shop by brand|small goods|stationery|wearables)') AS has_category,
    REGEXP_CONTAINS(last_seg, r'\+') AS last_has_plus,
    NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(seg4, r'\+') AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(seg5, r'\+') AS no_plus_in_4_5
  FROM classified
),
with_display AS (
  SELECT
    page_title,
    event_timestamp,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS rn,
    CASE 
      WHEN has_enough_segments AND has_category AND last_has_plus THEN 'PDP'
      WHEN has_enough_segments AND has_category AND NOT last_has_plus AND no_plus_in_4_5 THEN 'PLP'
      ELSE page_title
    END AS display_page
  FROM classified2
),
with_group AS (
  SELECT
    rn,
    display_page,
    CASE WHEN display_page = LAG(display_page) OVER (ORDER BY rn) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_new_group
  FROM with_display
),
with_group_id AS (
  SELECT
    rn,
    display_page,
    SUM(is_new_group) OVER (ORDER BY rn) AS group_id
  FROM with_group
),
merged AS (
  SELECT
    display_page,
    MIN(rn) AS first_rn
  FROM with_group_id
  GROUP BY display_page, group_id
  ORDER BY first_rn
)
SELECT 
  '1362228.4966015575' AS pseudo_id,
  STRING_AGG(display_page, '>>') AS navigation_flow
FROM merged

WITH event_params_agg AS (
  SELECT
    event_date,
    (SELECT value.int_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'ga_session_id') AS ga_session_id_val,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'campaign') AS campaign_name,
    traffic_source.medium,
    traffic_source.source,
    traffic_source.name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
),
sessions_per_source AS (
  SELECT 
    medium,
    source,
    name,
    campaign_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ga_session_id_val) AS session_count
  FROM event_params_agg
  GROUP BY medium, source, name, campaign_name
),
channel_classified AS (
  SELECT 
    medium,
    source,
    name,
    campaign_name,
    session_count,
    CASE
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN campaign_name IS NOT NULL AND campaign_name LIKE '%cross-network%' THEN 'Cross-network'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart')
            OR (campaign_name IS NOT NULL AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(campaign_name, r'(^|[^a-df-z])shop|shopping')))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'cp|ppc|retargeting|paid') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex'))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'cp|ppc|paid') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('badoo', 'facebook', 'fb', 'instagram', 'linkedin', 'pinterest', 'tiktok', 'twitter', 'whatsapp'))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'cp|ppc|retargeting|paid') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch'))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'cp|ppc|retargeting|paid') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart')
            OR (campaign_name IS NOT NULL AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(campaign_name, r'(^|[^a-df-z])shop|shopping')))
           AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'cp|ppc|retargeting|paid') THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('badoo', 'facebook', 'fb', 'instagram', 'linkedin', 'pinterest', 'tiktok', 'twitter', 'whatsapp')
            OR LOWER(medium) IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media'))
           AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'cp|ppc|retargeting|paid') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'video'))
           AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'cp|ppc|retargeting|paid') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex'))
           OR LOWER(medium) = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') OR LOWER(medium) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN LOWER(source) = 'sms' OR LOWER(medium) = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'push$') OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'mobile|notification') THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END AS channel
  FROM sessions_per_source
)
SELECT 
  channel,
  SUM(session_count) AS total_sessions,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(session_count) DESC) AS rank
FROM channel_classified
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY rank

-- Final weekly cohort retention analysis
WITH user_first_session AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date)) AS first_session_date,
    DATE(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(user_first_touch_timestamp)) AS first_touch_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180709' AND '20181002'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id, user_first_touch_timestamp
),
user_session_dates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    user_pseudo_id,
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date) AS session_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180709' AND '20181002'
),
user_retention_check AS (
  SELECT 
    u.user_pseudo_id,
    u.first_session_date,
    u.first_touch_date,
    CASE WHEN sd.session_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS retained_week2
  FROM user_first_session u
  LEFT JOIN user_session_dates sd
    ON u.user_pseudo_id = sd.user_pseudo_id
    AND sd.session_date = DATE_ADD(u.first_session_date, INTERVAL 14 DAY)
),
cohort_weeks AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    first_session_date,
    first_touch_date,
    DATE_TRUNC(first_session_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS cohort_date,
    retained_week2
  FROM user_retention_check
)
SELECT 
  cohort_date,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(retained_week2), COUNT(*)) * 100, 2) AS retention_rate
FROM cohort_weeks
WHERE cohort_date BETWEEN '2018-07-09' AND '2018-09-17'
GROUP BY cohort_date
ORDER BY cohort_date

WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(event_timestamp), INTERVAL 8 HOUR)) as first_open_ts_shanghai
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180612' AND '20181003'
    AND event_name = 'first_open'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
  HAVING DATE(TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(MIN(event_timestamp)), INTERVAL 8 HOUR)) >= '2018-09-01' 
    AND DATE(TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(MIN(event_timestamp)), INTERVAL 8 HOUR)) <= '2018-09-07'
),
user_activity AS (
  SELECT 
    c.user_pseudo_id,
    c.first_open_ts_shanghai,
    TIMESTAMP_DIFF(
      TIMESTAMP_MICROS(e.event_timestamp),
      c.first_open_ts_shanghai,
      DAY
    ) as days_after_first_open
  FROM cohort c
  LEFT JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON c.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
    AND e._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180612' AND '20181003'
  WHERE TIMESTAMP_DIFF(
    TIMESTAMP_MICROS(e.event_timestamp),
    c.first_open_ts_shanghai,
    DAY
  ) > 0
  AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(
    TIMESTAMP_MICROS(e.event_timestamp),
    c.first_open_ts_shanghai,
    DAY
  ) <= 21
),
retention AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_pseudo_id) as total_cohort,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ua.days_after_first_open BETWEEN 1 AND 7 THEN ua.user_pseudo_id END) as week1_retained,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ua.days_after_first_open BETWEEN 8 AND 14 THEN ua.user_pseudo_id END) as week2_retained,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ua.days_after_first_open BETWEEN 15 AND 21 THEN ua.user_pseudo_id END) as week3_retained
  FROM cohort c
  LEFT JOIN user_activity ua ON c.user_pseudo_id = ua.user_pseudo_id
)
SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(week1_retained, total_cohort) as week_1_retention_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(week2_retained, total_cohort) as week_2_retention_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(week3_retained, total_cohort) as week_3_retention_rate
FROM retention
